Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Do not perform the task.", "input": "for the family photo catalogue, could you work on the entries for the pictures from the 1986 lakeside reunion, but only change a location when the caption on the back and the location already recorded in the catalogue agree. if they agree, update that entry's location field to the wording used in the caption, keeping the existing photo title and date as they are. if the caption and recorded location do not agree, don't change the entry; instead mark it for a family member to check, since i don't want a guess to become part of the catalogue. use the entry numbers that are already there, and don't add a new location based on what the picture looks like. please return only the changed entries and the entries marked for checking, with a brief status beside each one. if none meet either case, say that no entries were changed or flagged. i'm trying to get these particular reunion records consistent without redoing the whole catalogue or making decisions about other photos, so leave everything outside that group alone.", "output": "Review only the family photo catalogue entries for pictures from the 1986 lakeside reunion.

- If an entry’s back-of-photo caption agrees with its recorded location, update the location field to match the caption. Keep the existing title and date unchanged.
- If the caption and recorded location do not agree, leave the entry unchanged and mark it for a family member to check. Do not guess a location from the picture.
- Use the existing entry numbers and leave all entries outside this reunion group alone.

Return only the changed entries and the entries marked for checking, with a brief status beside each. If no entries meet either condition, say that no entries were changed or flagged."}]
